brum_home1_nan.text: Come in, bab, mind the step. Kettle's on, it is always on. It is a Birmingham law.
'Bab' means love, 'bostin' means brilliant, and 'tara-a-bit' means see you later. You can say it to anyone, even the bin men.
Our back gate opens near the cut. In summer you can hear narrowboats and a heron complaining about the traffic.

then.text: I have already given you a flask, you cheeky thing. Off you go, tara-a-bit.

else.text: Mind the binfox on the way out. It once took a whole Sunday roast off my windowsill. Here, a flask for the road, bab.
